title: Edible Solo #048 (초콜릿 가나슈 케이크 · 체형 super hourglass · 인종 Middle Eastern · 메이크업 코랄 립 강함 · 배경 옥상 테라스(흐린 낮) · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)

Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, late 30s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, long wavy jet-black hair — full body dark chocolate ganache cake with fresh berries fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is real frosted cake curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, thick piped frosting standing out in deep sculpted relief, with golden sponge cake layers showing at the cut edges, nothing lying flat. Dense surface — BLAZING glossy dark-chocolate ganache frosting across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID fresh raspberries, glossy strawberries and gold-dusted chocolate curls set along the body, with tiny sugar pearls pressed along the surface, glossy ganache, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, heavy gold rings on every finger, and a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT ganache — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: opaque satin vivid orange-coral red lips, peach-gold eyeshadow, defined lashes, a warm blush.

Background: a bright modern rooftop terrace with a pale deck floor, a waist-high glass railing, a standard door and a city skyline in the daylight haze, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
